title: Navajo curse legend of Skinwalker Ranch
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Navajo curse legend of Skinwalker Ranch, about historical at Skinwalker Ranch, Uinta Basin, Utah, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: enter you went to basin and so there's a myth that involves the ute tribe fighting the navajos and i believe the navajo is sick these skin walkers these sorts of youths were collaborating with the united states government the navajo weren't so happy and so they cursed this particular spot of land with skin waters

The Ute tribe won't even talk about it. They call [music] it cursed ground, the path of the Skinwalker. And if you spend any time on the ranch, you start to understand why. Drones malfunctioned, helicopters lose power, equipment dies.
tellings.difference: Has the Ute calling it cursed and refusing to talk about it, leaves out the Navajo curse backstory, and adds drones, helicopters and equipment failing.
tellings.link_reason: Same legend of Skinwalker Ranch as cursed ground, the path of the skinwalker, tied to the Ute.

as_told.title: Skinwalker Ranch as cursed ground of the Ute
